verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly's docs say numeric experiment metrics are built from your own custom events and that experiments can run on data from an external warehouse such as Snowflake. That covers both sources the story names, but only through brief mentions. Missing for 10: documented detail on defining metrics directly from warehouse tables (e.g., SQL or table-based metric definitions), warehouse support beyond Snowflake, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can define experiment metrics from my own data — warehouse tables or ingested events — instead of a black-box metric store

citations.quote: You can also run experiments using data from an external warehouse, like Snowflake.
You must use custom events to create numeric metrics, which measure and analyze numerical values against a baseline that you set.
You can also run experiments using [data from an external warehouse](/docs/home/warehouse-native/snowflake), like Snowflake.
